params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: landing-feedback  Priority: P2  Area: site
Summary: How we work is fine as it stands, but the billing lines for production services may mislead (now: "A platform subscription with tiered writes and reads" and "A monthly operations retainer and a fee per verification"). The client framed this differently in a dashboard document; align the page with that framing.

## Open
- The dashboard document is not in the repo; the wording has to come from it or from the team.

Source: Portal mail:6 (feedback on the website content, forwarded by the owner). The client asks for the owner's view first, so this is a proposal to agree on before building.
params.title: How we work: reframe the billing lines for production services
